reason: We are a 9-hole volunteer club and GOLF.NL already handles tee times and payments for free. Two founders and not a single live club yet is not something I can put in front of the ALV as a safe choice.
objection: No references: Zwolle isn't even live yet. If two founders stop, our member administration and bar tab are stuck with an unknown party, and I have to explain that to 550 members.
would_change_my_mind: Two or three comparable 9-hole clubs that have used it for a full season and that I can call myself, plus a contract that lets us take our data out and stop after the pilot without penalty.
